About this collection and its sources

This is a selected collection of legislation and regulations relevant to AI, including related privacy, consumer-protection and professional rules. Coverage varies by state. New York and selected East Coast entries include more detailed code references and practical notes. It is not an exhaustive inventory or a determination that a law applies to a particular situation.

Practical notes are editorial suggestions for applying the listed rules; they are separate from the legal duties. Each entry shows its source-check date. A source-check date records when that entry was last reviewed. Sources are checked manually; the collection does not update automatically. Read the linked source for current text, effective dates, exceptions and enforcement limits. Where an entry uses a legislative research summary, that source is identified.

New York State requirements can apply within NYC; city laws add a separate local layer. Federal and other unlisted requirements may also apply. Proposals, standalone agency guidance, institutional policies and court-case summaries are outside this edition.
